rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. It uses the same Hawaii public-lands provenance recital, identifies land reserved for military purposes, states that the land is no longer needed, declares restoration advisable and in the public interest, and then restores a single described tract to the Territory's “possession, use, and control.” The child follows this sequence and repeats much of the language nearly verbatim, adapting the location, reservation history, and survey description. C21 and C11 are also very close examples of the same form, but C04 most closely matches the child's singular military-reservation restoration and operative wording.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all of such lands constitute a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United States by the Republic of Hawaii under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898, 30 Stat. 750
shared_material.parent_excerpt: which forms a part of the public land ceded and transferred to the United States by the Republic of Hawaii under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898, 30 Stat. 750
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared recital establishing the legal provenance of Hawaiian public land.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such tract of land is no longer needed for military or other purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that it be restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such land is no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that it be restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim statement of the factual predicate and intended administrative action.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The following-described tract of land located at Opihipau ... is hereby restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following-described tract of land situated at Ka Lae ... is hereby restored to the possession, use, and control of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: The operative disposition is the same sentence-level template with the place and land description substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Beginning at a pipe ... the coordinates of said point of beginning referred to Government Survey Triangulation Station ... thence running by azimuths measured clockwise from true South
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Beginning at point "B" ... is situated ... of U.S. Coast Guard and Geodetic Survey triangulation station "Ka Lae"; thence from said point of beginning by azimuths, measured clockwise, from true south
shared_material.explanation: Both proceed from the restoration clause to a survey description using a monument or point, triangulation coordinates, clockwise azimuths, courses, distances, and acreage.
